sources.title: Quantization entry numeric-payload arithmetic
sources.details: Linked 17.1 uses a 64×32 table: count 2048. Eight bits per byte, FP32 32/8=4 bytes/value, FP16 16/8=2, int8 8/8=1. Products 2048×4=8192, ×2=4096, ×1=2048 bytes. Actual CPU element_size and numel agree exactly; these omit scales, metadata and other model/runtime storage.
